name: Revenge of the Antagonist
source:
Gerald has never particularly stood out, and has always envied the more popular Damian, who Gerald thinks is undeserving of his popularity due to his lack of talent. Years after graduating from performing arts school, Gerald becomes a C-list actor who's usually typecast to act in antagonist roles. 

Meanwhile, Damian becomes a popular heartthrob who's usually the protagonist in romance dramas. His rival's success constantly reminds Gerald of his insecurities and makes him feel like a loser.

One day, Gerald gets the role of the antagonist in a romance drama. By chance, Damian happens to be the male lead in that same drama, and they'll both have to fight over the female lead. Because of his pent-up jealousy and insecurities, Gerald swears to use various underhand tactics on set to embarrass his rival. Damian, on the other hand, is not going to sit back and let himself be provoked.

[Edited from [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/revenge-of-the-antagonist]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
杰拉德从来没有特别引人注目，并且一直羡慕更受欢迎的达米安，杰拉德认为达米安由于缺乏才华而配不上他的受欢迎程度。从表演艺术学校毕业多年后，杰拉德成为了一名三流演员，通常扮演反派角色。

与此同时，达米安成为了一个受欢迎的万人迷，他通常是浪漫戏剧中的主角。对手的成功不断提醒杰拉德他的不安全感，让他感觉自己像个失败者。

有一天，杰拉德在一部浪漫剧中扮演反派角色。一次偶然的机会，达米安恰好是同一部剧中的男主角，他们必须争夺女主角。由于压抑已久的嫉妒和不安全感，杰拉德发誓要在片场使用各种不正当手段让对手难堪。另一方面，达米安不会袖手旁观，任由自己被激怒。
